purpose: Teach: 温室/鶏肉/ダイニング/ガレージ/ライブラリー/エレクトロニクス/モノクロ/矢印

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお家、温室があるのよ
lines.en: Sho, did you know my place has a greenhouse?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone with gentle curiosity. Speaking as though sharing a small treasure. Soft opening, patient rhythm. The voice of someone offering inclusion.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんと鶏肉のおかず作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom and I made chicken for dinner.
lines.style: Bright, earnest delivery. Quick rhythm, proud of the accomplishment but not boasting. Eager to share something made with his mother. Open, unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しいお家のダイニング、広いわね
lines.en: Sho, the dining room in my new place is really spacious.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost thinking aloud. Soft, warm tone. Slight pause before speaking as though noticing it for the first time. Inviting him into her quiet noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんがガレージで自転車直してくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa fixed my bike in the garage.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact. Quick, genuine excitement without performing it. The cadence of a child sharing something important that happened. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、地域のライブラリーで本を借りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we borrow some books from the library in our neighborhood?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, warm invitation. Measured pace, the voice of someone including him in plans. Not commanding but offering a shared experience. Soft opening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんのお仕事はエレクトロニクスだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my dad works in electronics.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with underlying pride. Not boastful, just stating something true about his father. Small genuine smile in the voice. Simple and direct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おばあちゃんの古いモノクロ写真、素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, those old black-and-white photos your grandmother has are lovely, aren't they?
lines.style: Tender, wistful. Spoken softly as though admiring something delicate. Gentle appreciation in the rhythm. The voice of someone who sees beauty in small, quiet things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵に矢印を描いて道案内を作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew arrows on my picture to make a map for directions.
lines.style: Excited, proud delivery. Quicker pace, eager to show off something clever he created. Unguarded enthusiasm. The close of a conversation where he's fully comfortable.
